span.p:
Choose environments
trialgauntlet list
fleet 52 | ledger 42 | config 44 tasks

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Audit first
trialgauntlet audit
no-op, random, always-refuse,
scripted-oracle, greedy-unsafe

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
AUDIT PASSED?
trivial baselines <= 5%,
oracle 100%, shortcut caught

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Fix the environment or grader,
re-run the audit
(see troubleshooting chart)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Optional: stress the suites with scripted agents
run --agent gullible --inject all
run --agent oracle --fault mixed:0.3

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Point at a model server
llama-server --jinja ...
trialgauntlet doctor --base-url URL

span.p:
Full run, n trials per task
run --agent llm --env all --n 8 --k 4
--run-dir runs/X --out results/X.json
(resumable: re-run the same command)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Report
trialgauntlet report results
tables + SVG charts

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Read pass@1 next to pass^k
the gap is the inconsistency
pass@1 alone hides
